description: Browse and manage contact persons within partner organizations. This entity serves as a central hub for managing individual contacts, their roles, and communication details, facilitating effective relationship management.

pages.name: ContactListComponent
pages.description: This page provides a comprehensive list of all contact persons associated with partner organizations. Users can view, search, filter, create, edit, and manage contact details efficiently. It's the primary interface for overseeing individual relationships within the partnership ecosystem.

buttons.label: New Contact
buttons.description: Initiates the process to create a new contact or modify an existing one. This button opens a dialog where you can enter or update contact details such as name, email, title, and associated partner.
when_to_use: When you need to add a new contact person to the system.
When you need to update the details of an existing contact (after selecting them from the list).

buttons.label: Scan Business Card
buttons.description: Opens the business card scanner interface, allowing you to capture and extract contact information from physical business cards using AI. This automates data entry for new contacts.
when_to_use: When you need to quickly create a contact from a physical business card, saving time on manual data entry.

buttons.label: Import Contacts
buttons.description: Opens the import dialog, enabling you to bulk import contacts from external sources like Google Sheets or CSV files. This is useful for migrating large datasets.
when_to_use: When you need to add multiple contacts at once from external sources, ideal for bulk data migration.

tabs.name: Details
tabs.label: title.details
tabs.description: Provides a comprehensive view of the selected contact's personal information, contact details, and associated organizational data.

tabs.name: Interactions
tabs.label: title.interactions
tabs.description: Displays a chronological log of all interactions, communications, and activities related to the selected contact.

search.placeholder: Search contacts by name, email, or partner...
search.description: Enables users to quickly locate specific contacts within the list by typing keywords. The search functionality scans across various contact attributes such as first name, last name, email address, and the name of their associated partner organization.
search.help_text: To find a contact, simply start typing their name, email, or the name of their partner organization into the search bar. The list will automatically update to show matching results. For broader searches, use partial names.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're having trouble finding a contact, start by using the search bar at the top of the list. You can search by a contact's name, email address, or the name of their associated partner organization. If you need to add a new contact, look for the 'New Contact' button (usually with a plus icon). If you're looking to narrow down a large list, check for available filters, such as by partner organization, department, or role, to quickly refine your view.
common_tasks: Finding a contact: Use the search bar at the top of the page and type in the contact's name, email, or the partner organization's name. The list will dynamically update as you type.
Creating a contact: Click the 'New Contact' button (often labeled with a plus icon) to open the contact creation form. Fill in the required fields and save.
Editing a contact: Locate the contact in the list, click on their row to view their details page, then look for an 'Edit' button (often with a pencil icon) to modify their information.
Filtering by partner: Use the partner filter (if available) to see contacts from specific organizations.
Importing contacts: Click the 'Import Contacts' button to open the import wizard and bulk upload contact data from a file.
